fields.description: Issue features an "inside story" on an alleged beating involving Detective Lt. C. O. Huttoe and Chief of Detectives James Barker, framed as reflecting on the Miami police department. Additional coverage includes editorials and commentary on the Dade County Crime Commission and local law enforcement, discussion of bookmaking and racetrack gambling’s economic impact, a report on a planned Coconut Harvest Festival and Luau at Crandon Park/Key Biscayne, a divorce/annulment scandal involving Joseph E. Jacobson and Esther Jacobson, allegations about employment of minors at the Shandiclere Restaurant & Bar, a court report involving a child-molestation accusation and an assault case heard by Justice of the Peace Edwin Lee Mason, and political commentary on Miami/Miami Beach governance and transit-rate authority.
